DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の手続きですね。用紙で迷っているところはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is an address procedure. Is any part of the form confusing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越しの日の欄に、荷物を運んだ土曜日を書くのか、住み始めた月曜日を書くのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 土曜日の荷物搬入と月曜日の居住開始のどちらを日付欄に記すのか迷っていると相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: For the moving date, I am unsure whether to write Saturday when I moved my belongings or Monday when I began living there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the date field should show Saturday's delivery of belongings or Monday's start of residence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の経過を担当へお伝えしましょう。土曜日に荷物を置いた後は、どちらでお休みになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us tell the responsible staff what actually happened. After leaving your belongings on Saturday, where did you sleep?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜日の夜までは前の家で寝ていました。新しい部屋に泊まり始めたのは月曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日曜の夜までは旧居で寝て、新居に泊まり始めたのは月曜だと経過を説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I slept at the old home through Sunday night. I started staying in the new room on Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you slept at the old home through Sunday night and began staying at the new home on Monday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の搬入と住み始めを分けて伺いました。今回、あなたと一緒に住所が変わる方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have distinguished moving belongings from starting residence. Is anyone else's address changing with yours this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私一人です。ただ、新しい部屋には先に知人が住んでいるので、同じ世帯になるのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居者は自分だけだが新居に知人が先に住み、世帯の扱いも確認したいと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only mine. But an acquaintance already lives in the new room, so I also want to check whether we become the same household.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you alone are moving, but an acquaintance already lives at the new home and you want to check household treatment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その扱いは、同居の状況を担当が確認してご案内します。前の市で受け取った書類などはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check your living arrangements and explain that. Have you brought documents received from the previous city?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒ごと持っていますが、中の書類の名称が読めません。在留カードと一緒に、担当の前で出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前の市の書類を封筒ごと持参したが名称が読めず、在留カードと一緒に担当へ見せてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought the whole envelope, but cannot read the document names inside. May I show them to the staff together with my residence card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought the previous city's documents in their envelope but cannot read their names, and ask to show them with your residence card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なものを担当が確認します。書きかけの用紙にも、まだ決められない箇所があることをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check what is required. Please also say that some parts of the partly completed form cannot yet be decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付と世帯の欄は、自分で決めて埋めずに持っていきます。荷物を運んだ日と泊まり始めた日も分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と世帯欄を推測で埋めず持参し、搬入日と居住開始日を分けて説明すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring the date and household fields without deciding and filling them myself. I will explain separately the day I moved belongings and the day I began staying there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to bring the date and household fields unfilled rather than guess, and explain delivery and residence-start dates separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、書きかけの用紙と封筒をお持ちのまま、こちらの担当窓口へどうぞ。お話しされた二つの日も引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take the partly completed form and envelope to this responsible counter. I will pass on the two dates you mentioned too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の変更をご希望ですね。お持ちの票を一緒に見てもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wish to change a booking. May we look at your slip together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。来週の朝に検査と診察が書かれていますが、仕事が入り、診察だけ午後へ変えられないか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査と診察が朝の予約票を示し、仕事のため診察を午後へ変更できるか相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here. It lists a test and consultation next week in the morning, but work has come up, so I want to ask whether only the consultation can move to the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the morning test-and-consultation booking slip and ask to move the consultation to the afternoon because of work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査と診察が別の欄にありますね。検査の時間には、今の予定でお越しになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The test and consultation are in separate fields. Can you attend at the current test time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検査の時間も仕事と重なります。診察だけ変えればよいと思っていましたが、両方の相談が必要なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査も仕事と重なると答え、診察だけでなく両方の変更相談が必要だと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The test time also overlaps work. I thought changing only the consultation was enough, but I need to discuss both, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the test also overlaps work and confirm both changes need discussing, not only the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方の希望を伺って、予約担当と診療側へ確認します。同じ日に受けたいというご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will hear both preferences and check with booking staff and the clinical team. Would you like both on the same day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: できれば検査と診察を同じ日に受けたいです。ただ、その順番を私の判断で入れ替えるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査と診察を同じ日に受けたいが、自分の判断で順番を入れ替えないと希望を伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If possible, I want the test and consultation on the same day. But I do not intend to reverse their order at my own discretion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request test and consultation on the same day while saying you will not change their order yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望で確認します。予約変更以外に、今の症状について伝えておきたい変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check with that request. Apart from rescheduling, have your current symptoms changed in any way you want to report?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分ではいつもと違う症状は感じていません。日を動かしてよいかどうかは、診療側に確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分では普段と違う症状を感じていないと答え、日程を動かしてよいかは診療側の確認を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not feel any symptoms different from usual myself. I want the clinical team to check whether changing the day is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you feel no symptoms different from usual, and ask for clinical confirmation that moving the date is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまでは、新しい日時が決まったわけではありません。担当からのお返事は、どの方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until confirmation, no new date or time has been fixed. How would you like the staff's reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この窓口で返事を待ちます。新しい検査と診察の両方が確認できるまでは、手元の予約票を捨てずに持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口で回答を待ち、両方の新予約が確認できるまで現在の予約票を保管すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait at this counter. Until new bookings for both the test and consultation are confirmed, I will keep my current slip rather than throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wait at the counter and keep the current slip until both new bookings are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。まず両方の変更希望を照会します。回答が出たら、日時と来院前の案内を分けてご説明しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we will inquire about both changes. Once we have a reply, we will explain the date and time separately from pre-visit instructions. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見つからないとのご相談ですね。最後に見た状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want advice because you cannot find your bicycle. Tell me when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、駐輪場の白い屋根の下へ置きました。今朝戻ると、その場所には見当たりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日夕方に白い屋根の下へ駐輪し、今朝同じ場所で見当たらなくなったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday evening I left it under the white roof in the bicycle parking area. Returning this morning, I could not find it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you parked under the white roof yesterday evening and could not find it in the same place this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理する方に、整理などで動かしていないか確かめましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked with management whether they moved it while reorganizing or for another reason?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ連絡できていません。場所を間違えたのか、動かされたのかも分からず、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理者へ未連絡で、場所の取り違えか移動かも分からないと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not contacted them yet. I came for advice without knowing whether I mistook the place or it was moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say management has not been contacted and you do not know whether you confused the location or it was moved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かっている事実を順に記録しましょう。車体の特徴や登録情報が分かるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record known facts in order. Have you brought anything showing bicycle features or registration details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い車体の写真と登録の紙があります。ただ、この紙は前に使っていた自転車のものかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い車体の写真と登録書類を持参したが、紙は前の自転車用かもしれないと申告する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: A photo of the blue bicycle and a registration paper. But this paper might belong to my previous bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report bringing a photo of the blue bicycle and registration document, but say the paper may be for your previous bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 違う車体の番号を混ぜないように確認します。この写真は、今見当たらない自転車で間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check to avoid mixing in another bicycle's number. Is this photo definitely of the bicycle currently missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真のほうは今の自転車です。後ろのかごに黄色いテープを巻いたので、その部分でも見分けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真は現在の自転車だと確認し、後ろかごの黄色いテープが識別の特徴だと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The photo is of my current bicycle. I wrapped yellow tape around the rear basket, so that also identifies it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the photo is your current bicycle and report yellow tape on its rear basket as an identifying feature. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真とその特徴を伺いました。鍵について覚えていることと、今の自転車の書類を探せるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have the photo and that feature. Tell us what you remember about locking it and whether you can look for the current bicycle's documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鍵はかけたつもりですが、出る直前の動作までは覚えていません。家で今の車体の書類を探し、管理者にも連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 施錠したつもりだが直前の動作は覚えていないと述べ、現在車体の書類探しと管理者への照会を行うと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I think I locked it, but do not remember my exact actions just before leaving. I will look for the current bicycle's papers at home and contact management too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you intended to lock it but do not remember the final actions, and will find current-bicycle documents and ask management. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、鍵の状態と移動の有無は未確認としておきます。写真の特徴と駐輪した場所から、必要な相談を続けましょう。車体との対応が未確認の書類は、分けてお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will leave the lock status and whether it was moved unconfirmed. Let us continue the necessary consultation from its photographed features and parking location. We will return separately the document whose match to the bicycle is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の発送方法について、どのような記録を残したいとお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: For sending this envelope, what kind of record do you want to keep?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請書の原本を送ります。追跡で配達済みと出れば、提出先が申請を受け付けた証明にもなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申請書原本を送りたく、追跡の配達済みが提出先の申請受付の証明になるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending an original application form. If tracking says delivered, does that also prove the recipient accepted the application?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether tracking's delivered status for your original application proves the destination accepted the application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の配達に関する記録と、提出先が申請をどう扱うかは別です。提出先から指定された送り方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Postal delivery records and the recipient's handling of an application are separate. Did the recipient specify a sending method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には「送った控えを保管」とだけあります。到着したかと、誰が受け取ったかは、同じ記録で分かると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送った控えを保管という案内しかなく、到着確認と受取人の記録を同じだと思っていたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The guidance only says keep a copy of what you sent. I thought arrival confirmation and a record of who received it were available in the same record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the guidance only says keep a sending copy and you thought arrival confirmation and recipient records were the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できる内容は、選ぶ方法によって照合する必要があります。特に残しておきたいのは、発送の記録ですか、受取側の記録ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to compare what can be confirmed for each method. Do you particularly want a dispatch record or a receiving-side record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方です。ただし、受取の記録があっても申請の審査まで終わった意味にはならない、と分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送と受取の両記録を希望し、受取記録が審査完了を意味するわけではないと理解を述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both. But I will distinguish that even a receipt record does not mean the application's examination is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request dispatch and receipt records, and show you understand a receipt record does not mean screening is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。その条件で案内を比べましょう。料金を見る前に、封筒の中身と原本の確認はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let us compare guidance on those conditions. Before prices, have you checked the envelope's contents and original?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本は入れましたが、自分用のコピーをまだ取っていません。一度持ち帰って控えを残し、同じ封筒で出し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本は入れたが自分用コピーはなく、受付前の封筒を持ち帰って控えを取ってから送り直したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put in the original, but have not made a copy for myself yet. I want to take it home, keep a copy, then return to send it in the same envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the original is enclosed but you have no personal copy, and want to take the unaccepted envelope home to copy before sending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ受付前ですから、そのままお持ち帰りいただけます。次回も、発送と受取の両方の記録をご希望だとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: It has not been accepted yet, so you may take it home as it is. Next time too, tell us you want both dispatch and receipt records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: コピーを残して封をしてから来ます。発送と受取の記録の内容を確認し、その料金を見て方法を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本のコピーを残して封をした後に再訪し、両記録の内容と料金を見て発送方法を選ぶと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return after making a copy and sealing it. I want to check what both records contain, look at the fees and choose a method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return after copying the original and sealing the envelope, then choose a method after checking both records and fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日伺った条件をこの案内に書き留めます。申請を受け付けたかどうかは、提出先への確認も別に行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will write today's conditions on this guide. Separately check with the destination whether the application was accepted too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与を受け取るための口座をご希望ですね。申し込みの前に確認したい点はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want an account for receiving salary. Anything to check before applying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社ではミドルネームを省いた名前を使っています。本人確認書類は全部の名前なので、口座を申し込むときの書き方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社ではミドルネームを省略しているが本人確認書類は全氏名のため、開設申込の書き方を相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: At work I use a name omitting my middle name. My identification has my full name, so I want advice on writing the account-opening application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain work omits your middle name but ID has your full name, and ask how to write the opening application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、確認書類にどのように記載されているかを拝見します。勤務先から、口座情報の提出について案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First let us see how the identification records it. Has work given guidance on submitting account details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日までに出すよう言われましたが、口座番号だけなのか、名義が分かるものも要るのか書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社の提出期限は明日だが番号だけか名義資料も必要か不明だと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They told me to submit by tomorrow, but it does not say whether only the account number or proof of account-holder name is also needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the company deadline is tomorrow, but you do not know whether a number alone or account-name documentation is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先が必要とする情報は、給与の担当へお確かめください。こちらでも確認が必要ですので、明日までの開設は確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check required information with payroll. We need checks here too, so cannot guarantee opening by tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 申し込んだ控えを出せば、口座番号の代わりになると考えていました。控えがあっても開設済みとは違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申込控えを口座番号の代わりに考えていたと述べ、受付済みと開設済みは違うと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought an application receipt could replace an account number. Having a receipt is different from an opened account, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you thought the application receipt replaced the account number and confirm acceptance and completed opening differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、申し込みの受付と開設後の口座情報は区別してください。お持ちの本人確認書類と、勤務先が分かるものも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, distinguish accepting an application from account information after opening. Tell us also about your ID and evidence of your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードと勤務先の案内を持っています。この二つだけで足りると決めず、私の場合の追加書類も教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カードと勤務先案内を持参し、それだけで足りると決めず本人に必要な追加書類の案内を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card and workplace guidance. Without assuming these two suffice, I want to know any additional documents required in my case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought a residence card and workplace guidance, and ask about additional documents for you without assuming these suffice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの内容とご本人の状況を確認し、必要事項をご案内します。会社側の氏名表記の相談も、別にしていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check what you have and your circumstances and explain requirements. Could you separately discuss your name's form with the company too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 給与担当には、今は開設の相談段階だと伝えます。省略した名前でよいと決めず、提出物と表記を会社にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社へ開設相談中と伝え、省略氏名を当然とせず提出資料と表記を給与担当に確認すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell payroll I am at the account-opening consultation stage. Without deciding the abbreviated name is fine, I will check both submission items and name format with work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to tell payroll you are discussing opening and check required documents and name format, without assuming an abbreviated name is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらでは書類にある氏名の確認から進めます。記入欄で迷うところは空欄のまま、担当と一緒に見ていきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then here we will start by checking your name on the documents. Leave confusing fields blank and review them with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤の棚で何かお探しですか。お手元の商品と値札を一緒に確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Looking for something on the detergent shelf? Shall we check your product and the price tag together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二袋セットを取ったのですが、下の値札は一袋分ですか。それとも二袋まとめた金額ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手に取った二袋セットに対し、棚の値札が一袋分かセット全体か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I picked this two-bag set. Is the tag underneath for one bag or both together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the shelf tag for the two-bag set you picked is for one bag or the whole set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この値札には一袋の容量が書かれています。お持ちのセットとは商品番号が違いますね。何袋お使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This tag gives one bag's capacity. Its product number differs from your set. How many bags do you plan to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず少し試したいので、一袋でよいと思っていました。セットを取る必要はありませんでしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まず少量試すため一袋でよく、二袋セットを取る必要はなかったと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to try just a little first, so thought one bag would do. I did not need to pick a set.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say one bag is enough to try a small amount first and there was no need to pick the two-bag set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 単品の表示はこちらです。ただ、どちらも詰替え用です。ご自宅に、この商品の本体容器はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The individual-item display is here. But both are refills. Do you have this product's original container at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 容器もまだ持っていません。詰替えのほうが安く見えたので、それだけ買えば使えると思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本体容器を持たず、安く見えた詰替えだけで使えると思っていたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have the container yet either. The refill looked cheaper, so I thought I could use it just by buying that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you have no original container and thought the cheaper-looking refill alone could be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 初めてなら、必要な容器も含めてお選びください。本体にはポンプ付きという表示があります。ご希望はこちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: For first use, choose including the needed container. The original container says pump included. Is this what you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、今回はポンプ付きの本体を一つ選びます。詰替え二袋のセットは買わないので、戻す場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ポンプ付き本体を一つ選ぶと答え、買わない詰替えセットの戻し場所を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, this time I will choose one original container with a pump. I will not buy the two-bag refill set, so tell me where to return it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one pump-equipped original container and ask where to put back the refill set you will not buy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: セットはこの列へお戻しください。本体の値札はその隣ですから、容量と商品名が一致するか改めてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Return the set to this row. The original container's tag is beside it; check again that capacity and product name match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ポンプ付きの本体と同じ商品名と容量になっています。この本体一つの価格を確認してから、かごに入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本体と値札の商品名・容量が同じだと確認し、本体一つの価格を見てからかごに入れると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The product name and capacity match the pump-equipped container. I will check the price of one container before putting it in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm product name and capacity match the container's tag, and say you will check its single price before putting it in your basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、選ばれたのは本体一つですね。値札と会計時の表示に気になる違いがあれば、お支払い前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, you chose one original container. If the tag and checkout display show a concerning difference, tell us before payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の途中でお困りでしたか。こちらの案内所で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Having trouble during your walk? We can listen here at the information center.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とは別の道を歩いていて、私は疲れたので戻りたいです。入口で会う約束ですが、どの入口だったか自信がなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と別道を歩いて疲れて戻りたく、入口での待ち合わせ先に自信がなくなったと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am walking a different path from my friend, and am tired and want to return. We agreed to meet at the entrance, but I am no longer sure which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you walked separately from your friend, are tired and want to return, and are unsure of the meeting entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、今いるのはこの図の案内所です。お友達から入口の名前や目印について連絡は来ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, you are at this information center on the map. Has your friend sent an entrance name or landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人からは「花壇の横」と来ています。でも私が入った所にも花壇があったので、それだけでは同じか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の花壇横という連絡だけでは、自分が入った花壇のある入口と同じか分からないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend said beside the flower bed. But there was also a flower bed where I entered, so that alone does not tell me whether it is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your friend's beside the flower bed message does not show whether it is the entrance with a flower bed you used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図には花壇のある出入口が複数あります。確かでない入口を探して歩くより、ここで連絡を取り直されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map has several entrances with flower beds. Rather than walk looking for an uncertain entrance, would you contact them again here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで少し休みながら連絡します。私は案内所にいると伝えて、友人がこちらへ来られるか尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内所で休みながら現在地を伝え、友人が来られるか連絡して尋ねると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will contact them while resting here a little. I will say I am at the information center and ask whether they can come here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to rest at the information center, report your location and ask whether your friend can come. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内所という表示は建物の入口にもあります。お友達に伝えるときは、図のこの位置も一緒に示すと区別しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The building entrance also has an information-center sign. Showing this position on the map too will help distinguish it when you tell your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図の現在地と案内所の名前を送ります。「入口にいる」とだけ書かず、この建物で待つと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 園内図の現在地と案内所名を送り、単なる入口ではなくその建物で待つと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will send the map's current location and information-center name. Instead of only writing at the entrance, I will say I am waiting in this building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Send the park map's current location and information-center name, and say you will wait in that building, not just an entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらで待つことになったら、お友達の返事もお確かめください。長い散歩を続ける予定はどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If waiting here, check your friend's reply too. What will you do about continuing a long walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人から案内所へ向かうと返事が来ました。今日は長い散歩をやめ、合流するまでここで休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人が案内所へ向かう返信を受けたと報告し、長い散歩をやめ合流まで休むと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend replied that they are heading to the information center. I will stop the long walk for today and rest here until we meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report your friend's reply that they are heading to the center, and decide to stop the long walk and rest until meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 合流する場所が決まりましたね。案内所の休憩スペースをお使いください。席のことでお困りなら職員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The meeting place is settled. Please use the center's rest area. Ask staff if you have trouble with seating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路検索のことでしょうか。どこに、何時ごろ着きたいかをお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about route searching? Tell me where and around what time you want to arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の家に午後三時までに着きたいです。三時と入れて検索しましたが、この結果でよいのか見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人宅に午後三時までに着く約束で、三時を入れた検索結果の見方を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to reach my friend's home by three in the afternoon. I searched entering three, but could you check whether this result is right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to read search results entered as three, for an appointment to reach your friend's home by 3 p.m. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面は三時に出発する設定ですね。ご希望は、三時までに到着する経路を探すことですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This screen is set to depart at three. You want a route arriving by three, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家を訪ねる約束が三時です。出発の設定にしていたので、到着を基準に調べ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三時は訪問の約束であり、出発設定を到着基準に直したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The home visit is arranged for three. I had set departure, so want to search again based on arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain three is the visit appointment and you want to change the departure setting to an arrival basis. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 設定を到着に替える前に、検索先を確かめましょう。この駅への到着と、ご友人の家への到着は同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before changing to arrival, check the search destination. Arrival at this station is not the same as arrival at your friend's home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅から家までの移動を入れていませんでした。友人のメッセージには駅名だけなので、そこからどう行くかを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅から家への移動を含めておらず、友人に最寄り駅からの行き方を聞くと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not include the trip from the station to the home. My friend's message has only the station name, so I will ask how to go from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you omitted travel from station to home and will ask your friend how to get there from the nearest station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最寄り駅と、その先の移動を分けて確かめてください。駅までの経路では、速さと乗換えの少なさのどちらを優先なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the nearest station separately from onward travel. For the route to the station, prioritize speed or fewer transfers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 初めてなので、乗換えが少ない方を比べたいです。家までの時間が分かってから、駅に何時までに着くか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 初めてなので乗換えの少なさを優先し、家までの時間を確認して駅の到着目標を決めると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is my first time, so I want to compare options with fewer transfers. After learning the time to the home, I will decide when to arrive at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize fewer transfers for your first trip, and say you will set the station arrival target after checking the time to the home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その条件で検索し直せますね。結果は候補として、当日の運行案内やホームの表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can search again on those conditions. Treat results as candidates and check that day's service guidance and platform displays too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人への質問と、到着を基準にする設定をメモしました。乗換えの少ない候補を見てから、利用する列車を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人への質問と到着設定をメモし、乗換えの少ない候補を見て列車を決めると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noted my question for my friend and the arrival-based setting. After looking at options with fewer transfers, I will decide which train to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you noted the question for your friend and arrival setting, and will choose a train after reviewing fewer-transfer candidates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 検索する条件が整理できましたね。駅の先の移動も確かめ、表示を見てご乗車ください。それでは、お気をつけてお出掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your search conditions are organized. Check the trip beyond the station too and read displays before boarding. Travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書についてですね。どちらへ提出するための物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: About a certificate, then. Where will you submit it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋を借りる申込みで必要です。この紙にある証明書をお願いすればよいと思って持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸申込みのため紙の案内にある証明書を希望すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need it for a rental application. I brought this paper thinking I should request the certificate it lists.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want the certificate in the paper guidance for a rental application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の案内ですね。今お申し込みになる物件の案内で間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is guidance from the recipient. Is it definitely for the property you are applying for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛先を見ると前に検討した物件の紙でした。今の担当者からは、収入が分かる書類としか聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内は以前検討した物件の物で、現在の担当者からは収入の分かる書類とだけ聞いたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking at the addressee, this paper was for a property I considered earlier. The current representative only told me documents showing income.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the guidance concerns a previously considered property, while the current representative only said documents showing income. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前の案内を、そのまま今回の指定とは考えない方がよいですね。現在の提出先から、対象になる期間も指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is better not to treat the old guidance as current requirements. Has the current recipient specified the covered period too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期間も聞いていません。何という書類が何年分必要なのか、今の担当者へ聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象期間も不明なので、書類名と何年分が必要か現在の担当者へ聞き直すと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not asked about the period either. I will ask the current representative again what document and how many years are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the period is also unknown and you will ask the current representative the document name and how many years are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名称と期間を確認した回答があると、相談を整理できます。記載する情報の範囲についても、ご心配がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: An answer confirming name and period will help organize the consultation. Are you also concerned about the scope of information shown?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 関係のない家族の情報まで出すのか気になります。必要な記載項目と、私の分だけでよいかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の不要な情報が心配で、必要な記載項目と本人分だけでよいか確認すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I worry whether I must include unrelated family information. I will also check the required fields and whether my own information alone suffices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you worry about unnecessary family information and will check required fields and whether only your own information is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認内容を担当へお伝えください。今日は前の紙を基に申請せず、回答を待って相談する形になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the representative those questions. Would you wait for an answer and consult rather than apply today based on the old paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今日は申請を進めません。前の物件の紙は別にしておき、今回の回答を持ってあらためて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は申請せず、前の紙を別にして現在の提出先の回答後に再相談すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will not proceed today. I will keep the old property's paper separate and come back to consult with the current answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to apply today, separate the old paper and consult again after the current recipient's answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回の提出先の回答をお持ちになった際に、書類の種類や窓口を確認しましょう。それでは、またご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. When you bring the current recipient's answer, we will check document types and the appropriate counter. Please consult us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入で、分かりにくい表現がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are any expressions confusing when filling in the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ひざの痛みについて書いています。「持続する」という言葉が分からず、ずっと痛いに丸を付けてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ひざの問診で持続するの意味が分からず、ずっと痛いに丸を付けるか迷うと尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am writing about knee pain. I do not understand persists and am unsure whether to circle hurts all the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the meaning of persists in the knee questionnaire and whether to circle pain all the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでは痛みが続いているかどうかを尋ねています。痛みを感じない時もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here it asks whether pain continues. Are there times when you do not feel pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 座っている時は感じません。下りの階段で痛むので、一日中ずっと痛むという書き方では違うと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座位では感じず下り階段で痛むため、一日中の痛みという記述は違うと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not feel it while sitting. It hurts on stairs going down, so saying it hurts continuously all day seems wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no pain while sitting but pain descending stairs, so an all-day-pain description is incorrect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを、ご自分の言葉で書いておきましょう。痛みに気づいたのはいつごろですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write that distinction in your own words. Around when did you notice the pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週の買い物の帰りに気づきましたが、何曜日だったか曖昧です。正確な日を思い出せないと書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先週の買い物帰りに気づいたが曜日は曖昧で、正確な日付を思い出せないと書いてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed it returning from shopping last week, but am unsure which weekday. May I write that I cannot remember the exact date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you noticed it returning from shopping last week but the weekday is unclear, and ask to write the exact date cannot be recalled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる時期と、日付は不確かであることを伝えてください。体のどちら側かも確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: State the period you know and that the date is uncertain. Let me also check which side of the body.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右ひざです。右と左を取り違えないよう、指で示して説明したいです。難しい言葉の説明は、ゆっくりお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右ひざを指して左右を取り違えず説明し、難しい言葉はゆっくり話してほしいと求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My right knee. To avoid confusing right and left, I want to point and explain. Could difficult words be explained slowly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point to your right knee to avoid confusing sides, and request slow explanations of difficult words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 右ひざですね。ゆっくりした説明を希望することも伝えます。痛みの原因や対応は、診察で医師にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The right knee. I will also convey your wish for slow explanations. Consult the doctor during examination about causes and responses to the pain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 座っている時と階段の時の違い、日付が不確かなことを診察で伝えます。分からない言葉は、その場で聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 痛みの有無の条件と不確かな開始日を医師へ伝え、分からない語はその場で聞き直すと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the doctor the difference between sitting and stairs, and that the date is uncertain. I will ask again immediately about words I do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the doctor when pain is present or absent and the uncertain onset date, and ask again about unfamiliar words on the spot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を医師へ引き継ぎます。書き終わった問診票はこちらへお渡しください。それでは、診察のご案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that to the doctor. Please hand the completed questionnaire here. Then wait until you are called for examination.
